note: The original describes only the dealate male adult.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Closely related to A. grandifrons, from which it differs in that the latter has a conspicuous fontanelle, a larger pronotum, and a wider, rounder posterior emargination of the meso- and metanotum; in the present species the pronotum is shorter than in grandifrons and the sides recede posteriorly less broadly and gently; the posterior margin of the meso- and metanotum is angularly emarginate, whereas in grandifrons it is broadly and roundly emarginate.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Dealate male: head dark chestnut brown, wider than long (from posterior margin to base of postclypeus), covered with dense long and short hairs. Fontanelle indistinct, a large oval plate in the depression of the vertex. Postclypeus dark chestnut brown, slightly paler than the head, more than twice as wide as long, bilobed, projecting, covered with long hairs. Compound eyes black, not circular, large and projecting, adjacent to the lateral margins of the head. Ocelli transparent, nearly oval, separated from the compound eyes by their short diameter, upper margin projecting, forming an angle with the compound eyes. Mandibles yellowish brown, chestnut at the apex, elongate. Antennae yellowish brown, 15-segmented, gradually longer and wider toward the apex, covered with long hairs; segment 3 ring-like, narrower than and much shorter than segment 2, slightly shorter than segment 4; segment 4 shorter than segment 2; apical segment slender and long, nearly oval. Pronotum dark chestnut brown, slightly paler than the head, saddle-shaped, sides angular and roundly receding to the posterior margin, covered with long hairs. Posterior margin of meso- and metanotum deeply and angularly emarginate. Legs brownish, covered with long hairs. Abdominal tergites dark chestnut brown, with faint spiracular spots and dense long hairs; cerci fairly distinct. Measurements: dealate male body length 9.50 mm; head length (to the apex of the labrum) 1.60 mm; left mandible length 0.80 mm; pronotum length 0.75 mm, width 1.80 mm; hind tibia length 1.60 mm; compound eye long diameter 0.85 mm; head width (between the eyes) 1.45 mm.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Type locality Rosario, Bolivia; the description is based on three dealate males collected at the type locality in November 1921 (month 11) by W. M. Mann. The species is named after L. O. Howard, Chief of the Bureau of Entomology, United States Department of Agriculture. Holotype dealate male, USNM Cat. No. 27666.
